Download TapMirror.exe on your Windows PC and run it. It sits in the tray (no window, no console) and opens scrcpy when you tap the tile. It can download scrcpy for you.
Phone and PC must be on the same home network. If the PC isn\'t found, see Troubleshooting below.
The TapMirror tray menu on the PC shows it (\"This PC: …\"). Useful when searching fails, for example behind a VPN that can\'t be bypassed.
With root, TapMirror turns on adb over Wi-Fi on port 5555 only while you mirror, and turns it off afterwards. Nothing else to do.

Without root, TapMirror switches Android\'s Wireless debugging. It needs one permission that only a PC can grant: in the TapMirror tray menu on the PC choose \"Set up phone without root…\", or run this command with the phone connected over USB:
adb needs Developer options to be on: Settings → About phone → tap \"Build number\" 7 times. Without root, also open Wireless debugging once on your home Wi-Fi and allow it.
Add the \"Mirror to PC\" tile: tap it to start, tap again to stop. Long-press it to open this app.

With notifications on, a notification shows the status and a Stop button while mirroring. With them off, there is only the tile: it shows the status, and errors appear on the tile and in this app. Android requires a notification for this kind of work, so \"off\" means turning TapMirror\'s notifications off in system settings; Android then hides it.

1. You tap the tile. The phone sends a short message on your Wi-Fi to find the TapMirror app on your PC.
2. The phone turns on adb (debugging) for this session only.
3. The PC connects with adb and opens scrcpy: the phone screen in a window, controlled with mouse and keyboard.
4. When you close the window, tap the tile again, or the PC goes away, the phone turns debugging back off.

The first time a phone asks, the PC shows a window to allow it.

• PC not found: make sure TapMirror is running (tray icon) and both devices are on the same network. Guest networks and "AP isolation" block this. In the tray menu, choose "Allow through Windows Firewall".
• Some banking and government apps refuse to work while debugging is on. TapMirror turns it on only while you mirror; set "After mirroring" to "Always turn debugging off".
• Without root, Wireless debugging turns itself off when you change Wi-Fi networks; allow it once on each network.
• The phone may ask "Allow USB debugging?" for a new PC: tick "Always allow".
